I am too old now to be carrying heavy bags of chemical fertilizer from the market, and they cost too much money that I don't have. But my grandchildren help me collect cow manure from our animals, so I will put that on the small maize plot to help it grow. I will plant the seed I kept from last year's harvest because I know it, and I don't need to buy anything new. The rains will come as God provides, and I will pull the weeds with my hands like I always have.
